headline: Wild activate Jared Spurgeon off injured reserve
take: Daily Faceoff reports the Wild have activated Jared Spurgeon off injured reserve and sent Tyler Pitlick to the AHL. Spurgeon's return matters more than his five points in 11 games suggest. At five on five, Minnesota has taken 66% of the expected goals (the quality of chances) with him on the ice, 16 points better than when he sits, on a team already at 56% overall. The 13-3-4 Wild have actually been unlucky up front, 8.3 goals short of their chances, while Jesper Wallstedt covers for it by saving 14 goals more than expected. Getting a steady defenseman back eases the load on Quinn Hughes and on Wallstedt alike.
